answer: The wildfire_la footprint layer (data/raw/wildfire_la/buildings_2023_with_dins.geojson, 45,433 footprints, complete, no duplicate IDs) breaks down by DAMAGE as: Destroyed (>50%) 16,244; No Damage 12,107; Affected (1-9%) 1,583; Minor (10-25%) 319; Major (26-50%) 146; Inaccessible 41; and null (no DAMAGE record) 14,993. Counts sum to 45,433. Null means not inspected, not undamaged. Excluding null and Inaccessible, 30,399 inspected footprints remain, of which 16,244 (53.4%) are destroyed. Counted directly from the local GeoJSON with plain Python; no ArcPy needed since this is attribute tallying.
traps_or_caveats: Null DAMAGE (14,993, 33%) means no inspection record, not 'no damage'; reported separately and excluded from any survivor/percent calculation.
Inaccessible (41) is neither destroyed nor survived; excluded from the 30,399 denominator.
Layer was selected by the fires' final perimeters (within 1/4 mile), so counts describe structures the fire reached, not all LA buildings; the 53.4% destroyed share is not a general loss rate.

Unit is footprint polygons, not structures/addresses: includes 289 courtyard and 76 solar-structure polygons (365 non-building); with courtyards, one DINS structure may map to several footprints. Excluding non-Building codes: Destroyed 16,156, null 14,804 (+72 solar null, 117 courtyard null), No Damage 12,035, Affected 1,574, Minor 317, Major 141, Inaccessible 41.
Counts reflect the downloaded snapshot (manifest 2026-10-22, 45,433 features); live service may differ.
DAMAGE categories are CAL FIRE DINS visual inspection classes, not an independent measure.
